MuPDF 1.28.1 (https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/mupdf, tag 1.28.1), the WebAssembly build of
platform/wasm, with Printwarden's tools/mupdf/printwarden.c appended to lib/mupdf.c and
'export const libmupdfModule: any = libmupdf' appended to lib/mupdf.ts, built by tools/mupdf/build.sh
